usage: agentbreeder new agent [-h] --model {gemini} [--dir DIR |
                              --stack-for AGENT_YAML] [--dry-run] [--json]
                              name

Write a starter agent project to DIR (default ./NAME): agent.yaml, stack.yaml
(Postgres and LiteLLM), stack/litellm/config.yaml, and editable sources in
src/prompt/ and src/evals/. Publishes prompt/NAME-prompt@0.1.0 and eval/NAME-
evals@0.1.0 into DIR/registry and writes agent.lock. DIR must not exist or be
an empty directory.

positional arguments:
  name                  Agent name: [a-z][a-z0-9-], at most 31 characters

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model {gemini}      Model provider (only providers run end to end are
                        offered)
  --dir DIR             Destination (default ./NAME)
  --stack-for AGENT_YAML
                        Instead of a starter, write stack.yaml and
                        stack/litellm/config.yaml beside an existing
                        agent.yaml named NAME (onboarding an agent.yaml alone)
  --dry-run             Show what would be written
  --json                Print the result as JSON
